import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/Users/bakulbadwal/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p03-csv-evening-trips/shuttle_trips.csv')

# Convert to datetime
df['departure'] = pd.to_datetime(df['departure'])
df['arrival'] = pd.to_datetime(df['arrival'])

# Calculate trip duration in minutes
df['duration_minutes'] = (df['arrival'] - df['departure']).dt.total_seconds() / 60

# Filter: departure at or after 18:00 (6 PM) AND duration > 90 minutes
# Extract hour from departure
df['departure_hour'] = df['departure'].dt.hour

filtered = df[(df['departure_hour'] >= 18) & (df['duration_minutes'] > 90)]
print("Filtered trips:")
print(filtered[['trip_id', 'route', 'departure', 'arrival', 'duration_minutes']])
print(f"\nCount: {len(filtered)}")
